decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent 2023 launch that still had its own product page in 2024, the compact dumper appears to have enough ongoing commercial traction and low strategic stretch to justify keeping the option open.

The articulated construction dumper stays close to the firm's established construction equipment range and remained fully presented in 2024, so the evidence favors continued market support rather than abandonment.

Because the underground mine rescue vehicle is relatively distant from the established offer and was reduced from a full page in 2023 to only a mention in 2024, the results suggest limited realized value and a weaker case for further commitment.

The compact telescopic loader is an adjacent extension of the firm's existing capabilities and its continued standalone presentation in 2024 indicates enough remaining upside to keep it in the portfolio.

The material lift should be kept because it is close to the existing offer and the reported large order and strong rental popularity provide direct evidence that the product's value is being realized.

Despite being more distant from the established range, the compact underground mining loader shows strong early validation through intensive real-world use after seven months, which supports further exploitation of this option.
